_why: ONE list of margin pairs, read by BOTH encodings of ruling #178's bounds — the TypeScript predicate `isUsableMargin` (packages/ai/src/__tests__/gate-admin4-platform-rate.test.ts) and the Postgres CHECK `platform_rates_margin_bounds` (scripts/check-platform-rates-invariants.sh). ⚠️ THE CLASS THIS CLOSES: round 4 encoded the same bound twice and the two disagreed over a range of LEGAL inputs — `5 * "marginDenominator"` is int4*int4 and int4mul RAISES rather than widening, so every margin with a denominator above 429,496,729 aborted with an unnamed `integer out of range` while `isUsableMargin` returned true for the identical pair. Widening the list by hand closes instances; DERIVING both sides from one list closes the class, because a case added here is answered by both encodings or by neither.
